coordinates: CSS px relative to the viewport (1440x810). Multiply by 2 for video pixels.

fields.tMs: ms from clip start; the key lands on this frame
fields.focusAtPress: focused element measured right after the press (transitions not yet run)
fields.focus: focused element once settled, measured just before the next key or at clip end; use this for overlays and zooms
fields.ringBox: box plus outline width and offset: the visible focus ring. null when the page draws no outline
